name: qs-design
description: Business-truth-grounded, context-isolated product design with explicit attention, prototype and scoped-change verification.

interface.shortDescription: 业务事实驱动、变更有边界的跨平台产品设计
interface.longDescription: 从对话或现有产品建立 Product Truth、注意力、术语和原型合同，再形成一至三个必要方向；让结构和操作先完成解释，用稳定元素身份保护已批准决定，并以可验证的原生表达交付 iOS、Android、Web、微信和支付宝体验。
defaultPrompt: Use QS Design to compile an authorized task context, model the business, and explore one to three genuinely different directions according to uncertainty before modifying product code.
Freeze source-backed Product Truth, visible-affordance allowlists, first-viewport attention, terminology and prototype paths before formal direction generation.

Make structure, hierarchy, spacing, data and clear actions explain the interface before adding helper copy; keep critical facts visible and reserve tooltips for short optional non-interactive information.
Convert feedback into bounded deltas, protect untouched stable element facets, and use a propagation map before expanding an approved representative flow across the product.

Treat design, optimization, visual improvement and refactoring requests as design work even when phrased as questions; finish by embedding a rendered preview for every formal direction, plus a runnable entry for clickable or native work.
